newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU sets daily soft wheat export refund at zero.
newsitem.headline: EU sets daily soft wheat export refund at zero.

text.p: The European Union set its daily soft wheat refund at zero for exports to all third countries, an EU grain official said on Thursday.

Analysts said the move appeared to be designed to bring Switzerland and Liechtenstein, for which there had previously been a wheat refund of 1.5 Ecus, into the main "third country" category for soft or common wheat at a level of zero Ecus.
Daily or "common right" refunds are available on a first-come, first-served basis with a three-day reflection period in which the European Commission can veto bids.
Except for specially targeted exports, they are usually less attractive than the refunds available at the EU's weekly tender.
